name: Biomass Based Steam Generation Project by Industrial Progressive India Limited
description: Industrial Progressive India Limited has a milk processing plant situated at Village - Agwanpur, Dist Palwal (Haryana), having processing capacity of maximum 6 lakh litre per day. There milk product profile includes Acid Casein, Whey Powder (Demineralised), Skimmed milk Powder, Dairy Whitener, Ghee (Butter fat).  They need steam for milk processing which was earlier generated using coal fuelled boiler. Project activity involve installation of new biomass (rice husk) based boiler having capacity of 15 TPH at 17.5 kg/cm2 pressure to generate steam.

name: Guohua Rongcheng Phase III Wind Farm Project
developer: Guohua Resourceful (Rongcheng) Wind Power Generation Co., Ltd.
description: Guohua Rongcheng Phase III Wind Farm Project (hereinafter referred to as the proposed project) is located in Chengshan Town, Rongcheng City, Shangdong Province, the People’s Republic of China. The proposed project has a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW, consisting of 33 wind turbines with unit capacity of 1500kW. The expected annual power delivered to the grid is 100,263MWh. The power output will be delivered to the North China Power Grid (NCPG) via Shandong Power Grid.

The Facility, and consequently the Project, is owned by the City and County of Honolulu, Hawaii, and is operated on behalf of the City and County of Honolulu by Covanta Energy, headquartered in Morristown, NJ.  Heat recovered from the combustion of municipal solid waste is used to generate electricity, which is sold to Hawaiian Electric Company (HECO).

name: Biomass Based Steam Generation Plant Farmgate Agro Milch
description: The purpose of the project activity is to utilize rice husk available in the region for steam generation for captive consumption. The project undertaken generates steam by two boilers of capacity 8 TPH each using Biomass residues (Rice husk). Steam generated by the Boilers is used in the milk plant. The project activity falls under the Sectoral Scope 1: Energy industries (renewable / non-renewable sources) as per the sectoral scopes defined by the CDM Executive Board. The steam generation is carried out through sustainable means without causing any negative impact on the environment and thus helps in mitigation of climate change problem. The project is proposed as steam generation scenario utilizing biomass (rice husk) without having major alternation in the existing physiographic in the region.

name: Sichuan Baoxing Dongfeng Hydropower Project

description: The proposed project activity is a registered UNFCCC CDM project under reference No. 2945. As per § 3.12.8 of VCS Standard (version 3.2). The total emission reductions from the project are estimated to be 207,912 t CO2e in total over the period from project operation till date of CDM registration.

name: Bundled small scale wind energy VCS project activity by Envarrior Consulting Services-2

The project activity doesn’t involve any GHG emission sources. The estimated annual average and the total CO2e emission reduction by the project activity over the fix crediting period of 10 years are expected to be 5841 tCO2e and 58410tCO2e respectively.

Therefore the Project Activity is expected to lead to an emission reduction of 63775 tonnes CO2e annually.

description: Priyadarshini Polysacks Ltd. is a well known name in India in the manufacturing & supplying of woven poly sacks. PPL has set up this wind power project in the State of Maharashtra. The project activity is located at Panumbre & Mandur villages. It is part of Shirala Taluka of Sangli district. The project site is popularly known as Gudepachgani. This project activity has total installed capacity of 2.4 MW. It consists of four wind turbines of 0.6 MW capacities each. Suzlon Energy Ltd. has provided wind turbine technology for this project activity.

name: 10MW Biomass Power Generation Project - Tokyo Cement, Trincomalee
description: The purpose of the 10MW Biomass Power Generation Project is to come up with a solution for the severe power shortage in Sri Lanka through generating power using sustainable biomass energy by using agricultural waste material such as rice husk, sawdust and sustainable energy crops such as Gliricidia sepium. This environmental friendly energy (electricity) will be used by the Tokyo Cement Company as a stable power supply in the production of cement to displace fossil fuel based electricity from the electricity distribution system (national grid) and at the same time to supply the balance to the national grid.

name: Yeong Yang 61.5 MW Wind Farm Project
description: The Yeong Yang wind farm project has a capacity of 61.5 MW, comprising 41 wind turbine generators, each with a capacity of 1.5 MW.  It will generate approximately 180,749 MWh per year, which will be sold  into Korea Power Exchange. The electricity generated will displace electricity from the Korean grid, which is produced largely from fossil fuel sources. For this reason, due to this project, it is expected that 112,812 tCO2 per year will be abated. The starting date of the project activity was February 28th, 2007, date when the construction permission of the electric work issued by MKE is dated. Turbines entered into operation between 16th November 2008 and 1st June 2009. Since then, the project has been operating continuously, and is expected to have an operational lifetime of approximately 20 years from its starting date.

name: Protection of a Tasmanian native forest - Project 1 - REDD Forests Pilot
project_type: Agriculture Forestry and Other Land Use
description: This project is on the private land of a family who have owned and logged the land for over one hundred years. The site is therefore under threat of continued selective logging with natural regeneration, a land management policy implemented recently across a significant swathe of the property. The owners are seeking an alternative which will provide them with a comparable income, while protecting and improving the native forests of the region. This will support local biodiversity conservation, maintain watersheds and enhance carbon stocks.

name: Methane capture and destruction on Las Heras landfill project in Mendoza, Argentina
description: The small-scale project activity is to build, operate and maintain a landfill gas collection and flaring system on the Las Heras landfill in Mendoza, Argentina. It is an anaerobic managed landfill opened in 2001, operated by IMPSA Servicios Ambientales.

name: Fuhui Inner Mongolia Tugurige Wind Farm Project
developer: Bayannaoer Wulatezhongqi Fuhui Wind Power Co., Ltd
description: Located on the border with Outer Mongolia, the Tugurige wind farm involves the installation of 66 wind turbines

name: 8.5 MW Bundled wind power project in India
description: The project activity is a bundled wind energy project with total capacity of 8.5 MW, comprising of 11 Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) of different capacities (including 600 KW, 800 KW and 1250 KW), commissioned in the period 26/09/2008 to 31/03/2010. The relevant details of the individual components of the bundled project activity including the names of the project promoters, the installed wind power generation capacity for each wind turbine and the unique wind turbine number of the wind turbines have been tabulated.

name: Shenyang Laohuchong LFG Power Generation Project
developer: Shenyang Laohuchong Municipal Solid Waste Manageme
description: The purpose of the project is to capture and burn biogas, generating electricity, at the Shenyang Laohuchong Municipal Solid Waste landfill in China. Laohuchong landfill receives approximately 355,900 tons per year of domestic and non-hazardous industrial waste. The landfill has started its operation in 2003 and will be closed on 2025. The project will have an electricity component with an installed capacity reaching 3 MW. The project is based on two complementary activities, the extraction and flaring of landfill gas and the electricity generation and displacement to the grid that will effect a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions through two different ways: a) the destruction of the methane; and b) the reduction of a certain amount of fossil fuel used to generate electricity that will be substituted by the electricity generated in the biogas plant.

name: Electricity generation through wind power project at Jodhpur, Rajasthan
description: The proposed project activity is Wind Power Project with installed capacity of 3.2 MW enabling generation of electricity by Wind Electricity Generator (WEG) in the State of Rajasthan by M/s Paranjape Autocast Pvt. Ltd. There are four WEGs installed of 0.8 MW capacities each. Details of project activity are as follows: Capacity : 3.2 MW (0.8 MW X 4 Nos.) Taluka : Jodhpur & Oshiyan Dist. : Jodhpur State : Rajasthan

name: 21.05 MW bundled wind energy project in Maharashtra aggregated by Resurge Energy Private Limited
description: The project activity is located in the districts of Nandurbar, Sangli and Dhule, Maharashtra, India. The project activity involves the installation of 17 wind mills of three different capacity of seven 1.25 MW, seven 1.5 MW capacity and three 0.6 MW capacity tuned to an aggregated capacity of 21.05 MW. The proposed project would generate energy from wind resources thereby displacing, electricity generated using existing fossil fuel based power plants or future capacity additions in the State of Maharashtra.

name: 24.75 MW Ranganathaswamy Mini Hydel Project, Karnataka, India
description: The purpose of the project activity is to generate electricity using hydro potential available from surplus water flowing over Shiva anicut across Cauvery River. The project is a run of the river project that utilises a gradient of about 120 metres available at Gaganachukki falls and is situated on the right bank of Shiva Anicut near Shivasamudram Hamlet in Kollegal Taluk of Chamrajnagar District in Karnataka. The generated electricity will be exported to a grid system of Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited (BESCOM), a distribution company, which is a part of Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (KPTCL), a state government owned power transmission company.

name: Heilongjiang Wangkui 50MW Level Biomass Cogeneration Project
description: Heilongjiang Wangkui 50MW Level Biomass Cogeneration Project will utilize local surplus renewable biomass residues (maize stalks, wood residues and rice husk) for generating electricity. The install capacity is 30MW. The proposed project has installed one straw-fired boilers, imported from Denmark BWE Company, which is a world leading company in biomass boilers production and biomass cogeneration. The proposed project has also installed one turbine and one generator, which are produced domestically. The proposed project has also constructed 2 individual biomass residues collection stations around the plant. It is estimated that the Project can deliver 200 GWh of electricity to the Northeast China Grid per year, which consumes nearly 296,072 tons biomass residues.

name: Bundled wind power project in Tamil Nadu, India
description: The project activity is a 19.8 MW grouped activity generating wind power in the state of Tamil Nadu which forms a part of the Southern Regional grid of India. A part of the electricity is used for captive power generation (8.0 MW) while the remaining electricity is sold to the grid (11.8 MW) as per the Power Purchase Agreement between the project promoters and the Tamil Nadu State Electricity Board (TNEB).

name: Bos Dairy Farm Project
project_type: Livestock, enteric fermentation, and manure management
description: Reduction of methane production from anaerobic manure management system through removal of solids from manure slurry stream. This GHG emission reductions project was contracted in regard to its validation/verification under ISO 14064-2 and the VCS 2007 standard as another project activities type of project (TYPE III).

name: 8MW biomass based power plant at Phagwara
description: The project activity, located at the JCT textile mills in the state of Punjab, India, involves the installation of a rice husk based cogeneration plant for captive power generation. The project activity which is based on a carbon neutral fuel generates electricity and steam to meet JCT’s in-house electricity requirement thereby replacing an equivalent amount of electricity the plant would have drawn from the Northern grid. The project activity will reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions produced by the regional grid which is dominated by fossil fuel based power plants.

name: Qian'an Wangxin Caizi Town Windfarm Project Phase I
developer: Qian’an IW Power Co., Ltd, P.R.China
description: Qian’an Wangxin Caizi Town Windfarm Project Phase I (hereafter referred as the Project) is located at Caizi Town, Qian’an County, Songyuan City, Jilin Province, People’s Republic of China. The objective of the Project is to utilize wind resources for electricity generation. The Project involves the installation of 33 wind turbines with each capacity of 1,500 kW, and totals up to an installation capacity of 49.5 MW. The electricity supplied by the Project is sold into the Northeast China Power Grid (NECPG). The Project helps reduce GHG emissions generated from the highgrowth, coal-dominated power generation.

name: BALKODU 1 HYDRO POWER PLANT
description: Balkodu 1 Hydro Power Plant is a grid connected small-scale hydro electrical power plant developed by BTA Enerji Elektrik Üretim ?n?aat Sanayi ve Ticaret Ltd. ?ti. Balkodu 1 HEPP uses the water supply of Balkodu stream and Divren stream in Çaykara district of Trabzon province of Turkey. Project proponent has obtained the electricity generation license of  Balkodu 1 Hydro Power Plant for 9.099MW  total installed power that will be provided by one turbine with a predicted electricity supply to the grid of 29.322 GWh.

name: Upgrade of Dominican Power Partners’ Los Mina power station from open cycle to combined cycle power generation
description: The proposed project includes construction of a Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSGs) that will take advantage of the open cycle generation of the existing natural gas based power plant in Los Mina to produce steam, which will in turn be used to power a 108 MW steam turbine. Los Mina power plant currently includes two 105 MW units, with average historical production of 80MW each, due to grid system requirement. The total capacity of the plant will increase from 210 MW to an expected 318 MW. The potential GHG emissions reduction are based on the fact that electricity generated by the project activity using HRSGs will offset electricity from the national grid which is highly fuel oil and open-cycle based. Furthermore, the project enables a higher supply of energy to the local market using the same amount of fuel, enables a better utilization of non-renewable resources, and in turn enables further development of the country, which is currently limited by its energy supply.

name: NATIONAL CARBON TRADING PROJECT FOR WEATHERIZATION OF LOW-INCOME DWELLINGS
description: Project Goals The CP is an innovative project to aggregate emissions reductions from weatherized residential buildings across the United States for the purpose of verifying carbon credits to be sold in the emerging carbon market.  The first initiative on this project is aggregating emissions reductions achieved in low-income homes that receive weatherization assistance from the US DOE funded Weatherization Assistance Program.  Future expansions of the program will include emissions reductions from non-low-income residential buildings. The brief project description focuses on the first initiative only.

name: Heilongjiang Bianfushan Wind Power Project
developer: Shuangyashan Longyuan Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Heilongjiang Bianfushan Wind Power Project (hereafter referred as the project) is located in Fengle Town, Jixian County, Shuangyashan City, Heilongjiang Province, P.R.China. Totally 33 sets of 1500kW wind turbines has been installed, providing a total capacity of 49.5MW. It is estimated the power supplied was 121,625 MW annually and achieve amount of 125,030 tCO2e emission reduction every year as per registered PDD. The purpose of the project is to generate power by wind and supply it to Northeast China Power Grid (NECPG).

name: Heilongjiang Wangyunfeng Wind Power Project
developer: Hegang Longyuan Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Heilongjiang Wangyunfeng Wind Power Project , (hereafter referred as the project) is located in Luobei County, Hegang City, Heilongjiang Province, China. Totally 58 sets of 850kW wind turbines were installed, providing a total capacity of 49.3MW. It is estimated the power supply was 120,069 MW annually and achieved amount of 123,430 tCO2e emission reduction every year as per registered PDD. The purpose of the project is to generate power by wind and supply it to Northeast China Power Grid (NECPG).

name: Guangxi Qiaogong Hydropower Project
developer: Guangxi Fangyuan Electric Power Co., Ltd.
description: The Project was one of CDM project and it was got registration on Unfccc  on 4 August,2011.The registration number is 4507.The project locates Qianjiang Town, Laibin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region..Totally 8 sets turbines with a unit capacity of 57 MW were selected for the Project, providing a total installed capacity of 456MW. There are two local suppliers for 8 sets turbines. Annual electricity delivered to NCPG by the proposed project is expected to be 2048.02 GWh.

name: Cobanli 19.03 MW Hydroelectric Power Plant
description: Cobanli HEPP is a run-off river type of project to generate electricity from renewable sources. The project will be constructed by Hidro-D Hidroelektrik Enerji Uretim A.S. which is subsidiary of Yuksel Insaat A.S. in energy sector.  The proposed project activity will be constructed on the Cobanli Stream, one of the streams of the Kelkit River in Cobanli Village in the boundaries of Golova District of Sivas Province in Turkey. The installed capacity of the project will be 19.03 MW and the annual electricity generation will be 48,204 MWh/yr.

name: Hydroelectric Project El Edén
description: The Hydroelectric Project El Edén (hereafter, the project activity or project) is implemented by Central Hidroeléctrica El Edén S.A.S E.S.P (hereafter, the project proponent).  The project activity is a hydroelectric power plant that utilizes water from the Río La Miel (“La Miel river”), located in the river basin “La Miel” in the east of the Department of Caldas, Colombia (hereafter, the Host Country), about 125 kilometres from the City of Cali close to the municipalities of Pensilvania, Marquetalia and Manzanares. The electricity generated by the project is expected to be around 111 GWh per year, which will be delivered to the National Interconnected System (SIN ). It will help to reduce thermal power generation in the SIN by providing renewable energy to the grid. Thus, it will contribute to sustainability by increasing the share of renewable energy and reducing GHG emissions.

name: 8 MW bundled wind power project, proposed by Ghodawat Industries (India) Pvt. Ltd.
description: The bundled project activity is proposed by Ghodawat Industries (India) Pvt. Ltd. (Hereafter GIIPL) that uses renewable wind power to generate electrical energy. The capacity of the project is 8 MW that includes a 5.6 MW (7 Nos. x 800 kW) located in the state of Karnataka and 2.4 MW (3 Nos. x 800 kW) located in the state of Rajasthan. This is a bundled project activity bringing together ten wind turbine generators at sub-bundle –I and sub-bundle-II to form a single VER project activity where the distinctive characteristics of each project activity have been retained.

name: Jatropha Agroforestry Senegal
project_type: Agriculture Forestry and Other Land Use
description: The Jatropha Agroforestry Senegal project developes Jatropha curcas plantations in the Fatick, Kaffrine and Kaolack regions, in central-western agricultural region of the Senegal. The Jatropha curcas plantations will cover a total area of 1411 hectares by the year 2020. The project proponent, African National Oil Corporation s.a.r.l. (ANOC), is developing the project in collaboration with CarbonSinkGroup s.r.l (www.carbonsink.it) and Agroils Technologies SpA (www.agroils.com).

name: Kohinoor Wind Power Project in Rajasthan
description: Kohinoor Planet Construction Pvt. Ltd. (“KPCPL”) is developing 24 MW wind farm in the state of Rajasthan in India. The project consists of 30 machines of Enercon make E-53 type WECs of 800KW capacity each. Annually, the project is expected to generate and supply 40.912 GWh of electricity to Rajasthan regional electricity grid which is part of the NEWNE (Northern, Eastern, Western and North-Eastern) grid in India. The clean and green electricity supplied by the project will aide in sustainable growth in the region. KPCPL is the project owner and project participant along with Enercon (India) Power Development Private Limit (EIPDPL) as the project participant for the project activity. The project activity is the first renewable energy project developed by KPCPL in India.The purpose of the project activity is to utilize renewable wind energy for generation of electricity. The project activity replaces anthropogenic emissions of greenhouse gases (GHG’s) into the atmosphere.

name: Weatherization of single and multi-family dwellings in Virginia
description: Project is increasing energy efficiency in single and multi-family dwellings through weatherization.  LEAP is a 501c3 nonprofit organization located in Charlottesville, VA whose mission is to lead the effort in local communities to conserve energy in buildings to promote cost savings, job creation, sustainability, local economic development, and environmental stewardship.  LEAP manages energy efficiency programs in accordance with this mission.  LEAP also collects data needed to measure and monitor GHG emissions that result from the energy efficiency retrofit programs.

name: 4.2 MW Wind Power Project by National Enterprises at Tamil Nadu, India
description: This project activity consists of electrical energy generation using wind energy and to supply it to the Southern grid of India. In this way the project activity reduces the GHG emissions which would have been generated by the fossil fuel dominated power grid of India.

name: Heishan LN1 Household Biogas Project in Jinzhou, Liaoning Province
project_type: Energy industries (renewable/non-renewable sources); Livestock, enteric fermentation, and manure management
description: Heishan LN1 Household Biogas Project in Heishan Jinzhou, Liaoning Province (the project) is located in Heishan County, Jinzhou City, Liaoning Province, and P.R. China. The project is designed to construct methane recovery and utilization system for each rural household of 13,104 in total. According to the construction plan, the construction is conducted in steps and phases. 3,429 household biogas digesters installation are carried out in 2008; 5,675 household biogas digesters are installed in 2009; the remaining 4,000 biogas digesters installation are constructed in 2010. The construction is strictly based on National Standard GB/T4750-2002 for biogas digester and GB/T 3606-2001 for biogas stove. The main objective of the Project is to dispose the raw manure from pigs by anaerobic digester with a volume of 8m 3 , and to collect biogas generated during the treatment process for thermal supply which meets the cooking and water heating demands of the rural household itself by biogas stove with a thermal flow of 3.26kW each one. Before implementing the Project, all the manure would be left to decay in the uncovered anaerobic mature management system, i.e. deep pit with depth of 1meter at least; the methane generated would be emitted to the atmosphere. In addition, the heat would in the absence of the project activity be generated by stove fired with fossil fuels 1 , which is stated in the investigation report on rural household biogas utilization by Heishan County on September, 2007. The scenario in the absence of the project activity is identical to the baseline scenario.

name: Electricity generation from bundled wind energy project activity aggregated by Resurge Energy Private Limited - VII
description: The project activity undertakes the implementation of the WEGs in the state of Maharashtra. The project will harness the wind resource for electricity generation and will displace the electricity generated from the grid which comprises mainly the thermal generated resource. The project activity can be categorised as renewable energy generation. The project is a bundled project activity which involves 19 investors and a total of 32 nos. of Wind Electric Generators (WEGs). The power generated is exported to the Northern Eastern Western North Eastern (NEWNE) regional grid of India.

name: Biomass based steam generation project by Sterling Agro Industries Ltd.
description: Sterling Agro Industries Ltd. (Sterling) has undertaken a project activity, which entails thermal energy generation using renewable fuels. The project activity is being implemented at Dairy products manufacturing unit at Bhitouna, Kasganj-Soron Road, Dist-Kanshiram Nagar, Uttar Pradesh. The project activity involves the installation of biomass based boiler with an installed capacity of 15 TPH avoiding use of coal in steam generation. The main fuel (biomass) used is rice husk along with other agriculture residues as available in the region.   In the absence of this project activity, equivalent amount of energy would have been generated from coal based boiler which would spew the comparable amount of GHG into the atmosphere. Hence, the implementation of this project activity leads to reduction in GHG emissions associated with the coal based steam generation.

name: Positive Climate Care 8.75 MW bundled Wind Power Project Activity in the state of Maharashtra, India.
description: The proposed project activity is a small-scale project involving installation of 7 wind electric generators (WEGs) of individual capacities 1.25 MW each. The WEGs are part of Suzlon wind farms in Dhule and Sangli districts of Maharashtra. The electricity generated is fed to the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) grid. The project is promoted by M/s Savita oil Technologies Ltd. (formerly Savita Chemicals Ltd.), M/s Rajesh Construction Company Limited, M/s Smita Steels Rolling Mills Pvt. Ltd., M/s S. Jogani Exports Pvt. Ltd. & M/s Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Ltd. The Project will lead to reduced greenhouse gas emissions because it displaces electricity from fossil fuel dominated electricity generation plants. The project is located in the rural areas of Maharashtra and implementation of the project activity has contributed positively towards the ‘Sustainable Development’ in this region.

name: Positive Climate Care 6.25 MW Bundled Wind Power Project Activity in the state of Tamilnadu, India.
description: The project activity consists of a bundle of 13 wind electric generators (WEGs) for a total installed capacity of 6.25 MW that includes 3 MW (750 kW X 4 machines), 2 MW (250 kW X 8 machines) and 1.25 MW (1250 kW X 1 machine) located at District Coimbatore & Tirunelveli in the state of Tamilnadu. The electricity generated is fed to the Tamilnadu Electricity Board (TNEB). The TNEB forms part of the Southern Regional Grid of India and it depends primarily on fossil fuels. Therefore, this project contributes to reduced GHGs emissions caused by reliance on fossil fuels. The project is promoted by Savita oil Technologies Ltd., Jasmine Industrial Corporation and Dhanlaxmi Fabrics Ltd. In addition to the strategic objectives to achieve increased share of renewable energy in the Indian context through a focus on wind energy, increased rural incomes,reduced poverty and empowerment of the vulnerable sections of society, the project in turn contributes to the sustainable development of the region.

name: Positive Climate Care 4.67 MW Bundled Grid connected Wind Power Project Activity in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India
description: The project activity is a Wind energy based power generation project of capacity 4.67 MW consists of 7 Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) that includes 3.75 MW (1250 kW X 3 machines) and 0.92 MW (230 kW X 4 machines). The WTGs are located in District Jaisalmer in the state of Rajasthan. The project is promoted by M/s Rajesh Construction Company, M/s Savla Twisters Pvt. Ltd., M/s Vijay Industries Ltd. & M/s Saurabh Agrotech Pvt. Ltd. The generated electricity from the renewable energy of wind power is being sold to the State Electricity Utility RVPNL (Rajasthan Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited) through a power purchase and wheeling & banking agreement. The current project activity replaces fossil fuels based electricity generation for the region, thereby contributing to reduced greenhouse gas emissions.The project is located in the rural areas of Jaisalmer and implementation of the project activity has contributed positively towards the ‘Sustainable Development’ in this region.

name: Zhang Jiagang waste heat recovery from sulphuric acid production for electricity generation project
developer: Shanghai Yangtze Delta Investment Consulting Co.
description: The project activity is located in the Jiangsu Yangtze River International Chemistry Park, which is 20km distance from downtown Zhang Jiagang, Suzhou city in Jiangsu Province. The geographical coordinate of the centre of project site is: East Longitude 120¡ã27¡ä52¡å, North Latitude 32¡ã00¡ä10¡å. The purpose of the project activity is to recover waste heat from sulphuric acid production process to produce electricity, displacing part of electricity supplied by the East China Grid which predominantly relies on fossil fuel-fired power plants for power generation. The project activity involves installation of Monsanto Heat Recovery System (HRS), which is created by MECS in USA, and Siemens condensing turbine and power generation units with the rated output of 50MW.

name: Energy efficient glass melting process at an opal glass manufacturing plant in Uttarakhand, India
description: The project activity leads to annual aggregate energy consumption reduction of 21.84 GWhthermal/year due to energy efficiency improvement initiatives and switching to a comparatively lesser carbon intensive energy source in the glass melting process at the greenfield opal glass manufacturing unit of La Opala RG Limited (LORL). Owing to the comparatively more efficient melting process set-up, the project activity results in lesser wastage of thermal energy input to glass melting process. Since the project activity utilizes a lower quantum of energy generated from a comparatively lower carbon intensive source to produce a given quantity of molten glass, it results in GHG emission reductions to the tune of 4,081 tCO2e per annum on an average as per ex-ante GHG emission reduction calculation provided in Annex-II of the VCS PD.

name: Shandong Changdao Wind Farm Project
developer: Shandong Changdao Wind Power Co., Ltd
description: The project involves the construction and operation of first phase extension project, first phase technology improvement project and second phase technology improvement project in Changdao County, Yantai City, Shandong Province in China by Shandong Changdao Wind Power Co., Ltd. The total wind turbines of the project are 23 and the installed capacity of the project is 17.55MW.

name: Yichun Daqingshan Wind Power Project
developer: Yichun Xinganling Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Yichun Daqingshan Wind Power Project is a grid connected renewable energy project located in Heilongjiang Province, Northeast of China. The objective of the proposed project is to generate electricity using state-of-the-art wind power generation technology and to sell into China Northeast Power Grid. The proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plant connected to China Northeast Power Grid.

name: Enercon Wind Farm (Hindustan) Ltd in Karnataka
description: The purpose of the project, Enercon Wind Farm (Hindustan) Ltd 68.8MW wind power project in the Indian state of Karnataka, is to provide reliable renewable power to the Karnataka state electricity grid which is part of the Southern regional electricity grid. The project will lead to reduced greenhouse gas emissions because it displaces electricity from fossil fuel based electricity generation plants.

name: Someshwara small hydropower project (24.75 MW) in Karnataka, India
description: The purpose of the project activity is to generate electricity using hydro potential available in Gaganchukki branch of Cauvery River. The project is a run of the river scheme, utilizing a gradient of about 20 meters downstream of the existing 42 MW Shivasamudram hydroelectric project. The generated electricity will be exported to a grid system of Karnataka Power Transmission Corporation Limited (KPTCL), a state government owned power Transmission Company.  The project involves construction of a diversion wall, canal intake, power canal, penstock, powerhouse, and power evacuation system and tailrace canal. The powerhouse consists of three turbine generator sets of capacity 8.25 MW each.

name: WHR CDM CPP
description: The Projct activity is 25 MW Power Plant which is generating electricity by recovering waste heat from two 500 TPD Sponge Iron Kilns at the existing facility of Godawari Power and Ispat Limited. Two WHRB were set to capture the waste flue gases from Sponge Iron Kilns and produce power of 25 MW in the project activity. The power generated is used to meet the captive power requirement at the plant and excess power generated is exported to the State Grid. Thus the project helps in mitigating the Green House Gases which otherwise would have been generated from fossil fuel.

name: Fray Bentos Biomass Power Generation Project
description: The proposed project activity consists of the 35 MW biomass-based surplus electricity generation in the industrial cogeneration plant that is a part of a pulp mill construction project and will be situated in the pulp mill site. Botnia mill site is located near the city of Fray Bentos, Department of Río Negro, Uruguay. The project activity is designed to use black liquor from the pulping process for steam and electricity generation in the recovery boiler.

name: 5.1 MW bundled Wind Power Project in Tirunelveli (Tamil Nadu)
description: The project activity involves supply, erection, commissioning and operation of 5 × 850 kW rated Gamesa Eolica make Wind Turbine Generator and M/s.Vayu Energy (I) Pvt Ltd as installed 1 x 850 kW rated Gamesa eolica make wind turbine generator. The total installed capacity is 5.1 MW.

name: 4.85 MW wind power project in Maharashtra and Tamilnadu
description: The project activity consists of installation of different Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) with the cumulative capacity of 4.85 MW, to produce electricity using wind energy generation technology. The electricity generated is export to the grid with the purpose of either selling it to the electricity board or for the use of their own captive consumption. The project activity is using environmentally clean and safe technology i.e. wind energy.

name: Feke I 29.4 MW Hydroelectric Power Plant
description: Feke I hydroelectric power plant project is located at the south of Turkey, in the Mediterranean Region, on the Goksu Creek, a main branch of Seyhan River, within the province of Adana, about 10 km to Feke district.   The project consists of a 80 meters long concrete weir at 6 meters riverbed elevation, 2405 m long horseshoe shaped tunnel, 5200 m long transmission channel, forebay, desilting pool, spillway, 120 m long penstock pipe and a powerhouse with 2 vertical axis Francis turbines.   Feke I HEPP project has an installed capacity of 29.4 MW and expected to generate annually about 117 GWh of electricity on the average.

name: 14.1 MW grid connected wind energy project in Tamilnadu by ITC Limited
description: ITC Ltd, in its packaging and printing facility, has installed 9 numbers of WEGs of total 14.1 MW capacity (4 of 1.65 MW and 5 of 1.5 MW). The main objective of this initiative is to meet the electricity requirement at the packaging and printing facility located at Tiruvottiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu in India. The project installs the model V82 Vestas-make WEGs of individual capacity of 1.65 MW and S82 Suzlon-make WEGs of 1.5 MW. This project generates electricity from wind by converting the kinetic energy of wind to mechanical energy and then to electricity by using the generators. The plant and machinery will be owned by ITC Limited, whereas the EPC contractors will be individually responsible for operation and maintenance of the machines supplied by them.

name: Liaoning Kangping Furaoshan Wind Power Project
developer: Shenyang Longyuan Hero Asia Wind Power Co.,Ltd.
description: Liaoning Kangping Furaoshan Wind Power Project (hereafter referred as the proposed project) is located in Kangping County, Liaoning Province, Northeast China. Totally 66 Goldwind 50/750 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 750 kW have been installed, providing a total capacity of 49.5 MW. With an average electricity supply of 97,486 MWh, the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reductions by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plants connected into Northeast China Power Grid. The proposed project is estimated to deliver 111,719 tonnes of CO2e emission reduction annually. It is noted the proposed project has an annual theoretical generation of 138,277 MWh, while the annual electricity supply is 97,486 MWh.

name: CGN Inner Mongolia Huitengliang Phase I Wind Farm Project
description: The CGN Inner Mongolia Huitengliang Phase¢ñWind Farm Project, developed by CGN Wind Power Co., Ltd, is a grid connected renewable energy project in the Huitengliang area of Xilinguole League, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, in the People¡¯s Republic of China. It involves the installation of 40 turbines, each of which has a rated output of 1250 kW, providing a total installed capacity of 50 MW, with a predicted power supplied to the grid of 126,916 MWh per annum.

name: Gansu Guazhou Daliangxi Wind Power Project
description: The Gansu Guazhou Daliangxi Wind Power Project, developed by Gansu CGN Wind Power Co., Ltd, is a grid connected renewable energy project in Guazhou County,  Gansu Province, in the People¡¯s Republic of China. It involves the installation of 33 turbines, each of which has a rated output of 1500 kW, providing a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW, with a predicted power supplied to the grid of 115,144 MWh per annum.

name: Generation of Electricity in Gujarat from Bundled Wind Energy Project Activity – Bundle 6
description: The project activity is located in the district of Kutch, Gujarat, India. The project activity involves installation of 17 wind mills of varying capacities of 1.5 MW capacity (1 wind mill), 1.25 MW capacity (2 wind mills) and 0.6 MW capacity (14 wind mills) tuned to an aggregated capacity of 12.4 MW. The Seventeen wind mills are located in Suthri, Kadoli, Panchetiya, Chandrodi, Naransari and Khodasar villages of Kutch district. The proposed project would generate energy from wind resources thereby displacing, electricity generated using existing fossil fuel based power plants or future capacity additions in the State of Gujarat. Gujarat is a part of the country’s NEWNE Regional Grid.

name: Jilin Da'an Dagangzi Wind Power Project Phase III
developer: Jilin CGN Wind Power Co. Ltd.
description: The Jilin Da¡¯an Dagangzi Wind Power Project Phase ¢ó, developed by Jilin CGN Wind Power Co., Ltd, is a grid connected renewable energy project in Da¡¯an city, Jilin Province, in the People¡¯s Republic of China. It involves the installation of 33 turbines, each of which has a rated output of 1500 kW, providing a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW, with a predicted power delivered to the grid of 95,390MWh per annum.

name: Generation of electricity from Bundled 25 MW wind energy project aggregated by Resurge Energy Private Limited.
description: The project activity undertakes the implementation of the WTGs in the state of Maharashtra. The project will harness the wind resource for electricity generation and will displace the electricity generated from the grid which comprises mainly the thermal generated resource. The project activity can be categorised as renewable energy generation. The project is a bundled project activity which involves 16 investors and a total of 20 nos. of Wind Electric Generators (WEGs).

name: Jilin Da'an Dagangzi Wind Power Project Phase II
developer: Jilin CGN Wind Power Co. Ltd.
description: The Jilin Da¡¯an Dagangzi Wind Power Project Phase ¢ò, developed by Jilin CGN Wind Power Co., Ltd, is a grid connected renewable energy project in Da¡¯an city, Jilin Province, in the People¡¯s Republic of China. It involves the installation of 33 turbines, each of which has a rated output of 1500 kW, providing a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW, with a predicted power delivered to the grid of 103,130MWh per annum.

name: Sebenoba 30 MW Wind Farm
description: The 30 MW Wind Power Project is located close to the village of Sebenoba in the province of Hatay in Turkey. From March 2008 on, fifteen 2.0 MW wind turbines shall feed some 90,000 MWh clean electricity into the Turkish grid, thus avoiding some 60,000 tCO2 emissions per year, compared to the conventional power generation mix in the country. The carbon credits from the VCS scheme shall help to render the investment economically attractive and thus enable the climate friendly project.

name: Xilinguole Huitengliang Wind Power Project Guotai Phase I
developer: Xilinguole Guotai Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: The Xilinguole Huitengliang Wind Power Project Guotai Phase I is a grid connected renewable energy project in Xilinhot city, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China. It involves the installation of 66 wind turbines, each of which has a rated output of 750kW, providing a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW. The purpose of the project is to utilise renewable wind power to generate zero emissions electricity for the North China Power Grid.

name: Wastewater Treatment with Biogas Technology in Tapioca Processing Plant at Roi Et Flour Company Limited, Thailand
description: The proposed project activity is implemented at Roi Et Flour Company Limited, which at present has a full production capacity of 800 tonnes of native starch per day. The proposed project activity involves the installation of an anaerobic wastewater treatment facility adopting the Upflow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket technology, at the existing tapioca processing plant.

name: Inner Mongolia Sunjiaying 50.25MW Wind Power Project
developer: Chifeng Xinsheng Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Inner Mongolia Sunjiaying 50.25MW Wind Power Project  is a grid connected renewable energy project located in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, Northeast China. The objective of the project is to generate electricity using state-of-the-art wind power generation technology and to sell into the State Power Grid. The project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plant connected into China Northeast Power Grid. The project is located in Wengniute County, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. Totally 67 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 750KW have been installed, providing a total capacity of 50.25MW. The area has relative rich wind resource. With an average annual generation of 120.94GWh, the project is estimated to produce 138585 tonnes CO2 emission reduction annually.

name: Inner Mongolia Bayannaoer Chuanjingsumu 49.3MW Wind Power Project
description: Inner Mongolia Bayannaoer Chuanjingsumu 49.3MW Wind Power Project is a grid connected renewable energy project located in West Mongolia, North of China.The objective of the project is to generate electricity using state-of-the-art wind power generation technology and to sell into North China Power Grid. The project is located at the grassland in Chuanjingsumu, Middle Wulate County, Bayannaoer City, Inner Mongolia, North China. Totally 58 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 850 KW have been installed, providing a total capacity of 49.3 MW. Bayannaoer area has relative rich wind resource. With an average annual generation of 112.78 GWh, the project is estimated to deliver 121295 tonnes CO2 emission reduction annually.

name: Heilongjiang Huanan Hengdaishan West Wind Power Project
developer: Huanan Longyuan Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Heilongjiang Huanan Hengdaishan West Wind Power Project (hereafter refers to the proposed project) is to build and operate a 45.05 MW grid connected wind farm, located in Hengdaishan, Huana District, Jiamusi City, Heilongjiang Province, P.R.China. The proposed project installs totally 53 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 850 KW. During the operation period, the wind generators will deliver about 93.294 GWh to the Heilongjiang Power Grid that is integral to and forms a part of the Northeast China Power Grid. The electricity generated by the proposed project is expected to displace grid electricity generated from fossil fuels and reduces GHG emissions by an amount of approximately 102,754 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent) per year during the duration of the project activity. A reduction of approximately 719,278 tCO2e is forecast for the first 7-year crediting period.

name: Heilongjiang Huanan Hengdaishan East Wind Power Project
developer: Huanan Longyuan Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Heilongjiang Huanan Hengdaishan East Wind Power Project (hereafter refers to the proposed project) is to build and operate a 24.65 MW grid connected wind farm, located in Hengdaishan, Huana County, Jiamusi City, Heilongjiang Province, China. The proposed project installs totally 29 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 850 KW. During the operation period, the proposed project will deliver about 51.30 GWh to the Heilongjiang Power Grid that is integral to and forms a part of the Northeast China Power Grid. The electricity generated by the proposed project is expected to displace grid electricity generated from fossil fuels and reduces GHG emissions by an amount of approximately 58,794 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent) per year during the duration of the project activity. A reduction of approximately 411,558 tCO2e is forecast for the first 7-year crediting period.

name: Generation of power from process waste heat at Hi-Tech Carbon, Tamil Nadu
description: In the project activity, low calorific value waste gas coming out of new carbon black lines (line 2 & 3 of capacities 55,000 & 60,000 Tonnes/year respectively) is utilized in 52 and 70 TPH (B 2 & B 3) boilers respectively, specially designed to generate high pressure steam. This high pressure steam in turn drives the turbo-generators (TG`s) of capacity 8 MW and 17.2 MW (TG 3 & 4 respectively) to generate power. The electricity generated by the project activity is exported to southern regional grid, after meeting its captive requirements.

name: Chakangrao Starch wastewater treatment and biogas utilization project
description: The project activity involves recovery of fugitive biogas from the wastewater released from the tapioca starch processing using Up flow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (UASB) in sequence before the open lagoon system. The generated biogas is partly used as a fuel in the boiler to produce thermal energy. However, prior to project implementation, biomass (rice husk) was used in the boiler.

name: Thanawat wastewater treatment and biogas utilization project
description: The project activity involves recovery of fugitive biogas from the wastewater released from the tapioca starch factory using an Upflow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (UASB) system and covered lagoons and utilizing the biogas produced as fuel in the newly installed gas engine to produce electricity, thereby replacing the electricity from grid earlier used by the project participants. In addition, the generated biogas is used as a fuel in the boiler to produce thermal energy.

name: MedcoEnergi Associated Gas Recovery and Utilization Project
project_type: Fugitive emissions from fuels (solid, oil and gas)
description: The purpose of the project activity is to capture and process associated gas that would otherwise have been flared. The captured gas is processed in an LPG plant. The installation of the LPG plant allows the recovery and processing of the associated gas into LPG, condensate, and residue gas. One of the main factors in choosing LPG as an option for associated gas utilization was due to relatively high composition (± 16% mole fraction) of propane and butane.

name: Heilongjiang Yilan Maanshan Wind Power Project
developer: Yilan Longyuan Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Heilongjiang Yilan Maanshan Wind Power Project (hereafter referred as the proposed project) is a grid connected renewable energy project. The objective of the proposed project is to generate electricity from wind resources using advanced wind power generation technology and deliver to Northeast China Power Grid. The implementation of the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plant connected into Northeast China Power Grid.

name: Burcbendi 27.33 MW Hydroelectric Power Plant
description: Burcbendi HEPP project is a run-of-river type hydroelectric power plant project located in Ad?yaman Province in South Eastern part of Turkey. It is about 35 km from the city centre of Ad?yaman and 32 km from Sambayat district. The aim of the project is to generate energy from the Göksu River. The project consists of a weir, upstream and downstream cofferdams, spillway, connection channel to forebay, tailrace channel, penstock, power house and a medium voltage switchyard. Since the power plant is a run of river type, there shall be no dam construction resulting in any land to be covered with water. Since there is no forestry in the region there shall not be any deforestation.

name: Jiangsu Qidong Dongyuan Wind Power Project
developer: Longyuan Qidong Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Jiangsu Qidong Dongyuan Wind Power Project (hereafter referred as the proposed project) is located in Dongyuan Town, Qidong City, Jiangsu Province, East China. Totally 67 sets of 1500 kW wind turbines (IT-77/1500-CII, Nantong CASC Wanyuan Acciona Wind Turbine Manufacture Co Ltd (NCWA)) will be installed, providing a total capacity of 100.5 MW. With an average annual generation of 206,350 MWh, the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by  eplacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plant connected into East China Power Grid. The proposed project is estimated to generate 190,543 tonnes CO2 emission reduction annually.

name: Zhejiang Wenling Donghaitang Wind Power Project
developer: Zhejiang Wenling Donghaitang Wind Power Co.,
description: Zhejiang Wenling Donghaitang Wind Power Project (hereafter referred to as the proposed project) is located in Wenling County, Zhejiang Province, East China. Totally 20 V80 wind turbines with a nominal capacity of 2 MW will be installed, providing a total capacity of 40 MW. With an average annual generation of 75,130 MWh, the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reductions by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plants connected into East China Power Grid. The proposed project is estimated to deliver 69,372 tonnes of CO2e emission reduction annually.

name: Sudokwon Landfill Gas Electricity Generation Project (50MW)
description: and (3) to construct clean generation system with renewable energy. The Sudokwon Landfill is the largest dumping site in Korea, dealing with wastes from Seoul, Inchon and Kyonggi province. From 1992 to 2005 cumulative waste amounts 97,074 kilo tonnes and yearly average waste to 6,934 kilo tonnes.2 The landfill site is composed of 4 sites. 1st site was reclaimed from 1992 to 2000 and 2nd site which succeeded 1st site has been reclaimed since 2000. 3rd and 4th site are plan to be reclaimed in the future. Central incineration station is composed of 6 units. 4 units was installed in 1996 as 1st phase and the other 2 units in 1998 as 2nd phase. Existing 6.5MW power plant was installed in 2001 and 3.38MW power plant in 2003.

name: Gansu Yongchang County Donghewan Cascaded Hydropower Project
developer: Yongchang County Minrong Hydropower Development Co
description: The proposed cascaded project  is designed to construct 4 run-of-river hydropower projects (named Yueyaya Project, Donghewan Stage I Project, Donghewan Stage II Project and Donghewan Stage III Project) with an aggregate installed capacity of 29.7 MW developed by Yongchang County Minrong Hydropower Development Co., Ltd

name: Gansu Huanghe Chaijiaxia Hydropower Station Project
description: hydropower station at the main stream of the Yellow River in Xigu District of Lanzhou city in Gansu Province, China. The main objective of the project is to generate power from clean renewable hydro power in Gansu Province and contribute to the sustainability of power generation of the North West China Grid. The hydropower station will install 4 bulb-propeller turbine / generator sets with a total installed capacity of 96 MW. The project involves a run-of-river design utilizing the natural water flow of the river and low head of 6.8 meters. The project will involve the construction of an integrated dam / power house type hydropower station with a dam that consists of a water retaining section, five flood gates and a water intake / power house section. The water intake will lead the water into the turbines after which the water is returned to the river.

name: Yingpeng HFC23 Decompostion Project
project_type: Fugitive emissions from production and consumption of halocarbons and sulphur hexafluoride
description: The purpose of this proposed project is to collect all of the waste stream of HFC23 from HCFC22 production process, and decompose it almost completely by an incinerator to be installed in Yingpeng Chemical Co., Ltd. HFC23 will be decomposed to carbon dioxide (CO2), hydrogen chloride (HCl), and hydrogen fluoride (HF) etc., with high temperature and low pH value, and be further processed by the cooling and de-acid process before being emitted to the atmosphere.

name: Sussex County Landfill Gas Combustion Project
description: The Project involves the capture and destruction of landfill gas from the Sussex County Landfill via an expanded gas collection and flaring system. The project is owned and operated by the Sussex County Municipal Utilities Authority (SCMUA). A pre-project landfill gas collection system was installed in Phase 1 of the Landfill in 1996 and expanded into Phase 2A in 2004. This system included on-site gas wells and piping, with landfill gas being delivered to a 1MW power generation plant located off site. The power generation plant is currently owned and operated by Lafayette Energy Partners LP (Lafayette), with whom SCMUA has had a gas sales agreement since January 2007. Landfill gas collected using the pre-project system and transported off site to generate electricity is not included within the scope of the Project.

name: Biomass based Cogeneration project by SSPL
description: The proposed VCS project activity is installation of 12 MW cogeneration plant in order to meet additional power and steam requirement. This cogeneration plant includes installation of 80 TPH traveling grate boiler and extraction-cum-condensing turbine. The boiler is designed in such a way that it can only be fired with biomass residues in their existing configuration.

name: Tongren Tianshengqiao Hydropower Project, Guizhou Province, China
description: Tongren Tianshengqiao Hydropower Project, Guizhou Province, China (hereafter referred to as “the proposed project”) is located in Tianshengqiao reach of the lower stream of Daliang River in Chuandong Township of Tongren City, Guizhou Province, P. R. China. The total installed capacity of the proposed project is 22 MW (2×11MW). The expected annual operating hour is 3,512h, the electricity generation is 77,270 MWh, the net power supply is 74,585 MWh. The surface area at the full reservoir level of the project is 0.58 km2, thus the power density of the project is 37.7 W/m2. Furthermore, there is a small hydro power plant named Caicong plant submerged by the reservoir of the proposed project. Caicong plant is a run-of-river hydro plant with the installed capacity of 720 kW, the annual average electricity generation is 4,000 MWh.

name: Sustainable Biomass based thermal energy generation VCS project of Talawakelle Tea Factories in Sri Lanka
description: The project activity is located in Nanu Oya and Watagoda in the Central Province of Sri Lanka. The project activity involves the installation and commissioning of 9 boilers of 600,000 kCal/hr capacities, tuned to an aggregated capacity of 13.4 MWth. All the nine boilers in the nine tea factories belong to the Talawakelle Tea Estates PLC are located in Central Province of Sri Lanka (80° 38'51 E to 80° 43'39 E longitude and 06° 55'01 N to 06° 57'37 N latitude)2. The proposed project would generate heat from renewable biomass resources thereby displacing the use of fossil fuel (diesel).The biomass is obtained mainly from sustainable Eucalyptus plantations grown within the tea estates. The heat generated is used for drying of tea leaves in the tea manufacturing process.

name: The SPM Group Biogas Project
description: The proposed project activity is a grouped project consisting of four farms under the SPM group – SPM1, SPM2, SPM4 and SPM5. Farms SPM1 and SPM2 each have two separate biogas units named as SPM1.1, SPM1.2, SPM2.1 and SPM2.2. The project uses the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) small-scale methodology AMS III.D for the methane component and AMS I.D for the electricity displacement component.

name: Cassava Waste To Energy Project, Kalasin, Thailand (CWTE project)
description: A CDM registered project, The Cassava Waste To Energy Project (CWTE project) is an improvement of the existing lagoons that have, for many years, been used to treat wastewater generated from the cassava processing plant of Asia Modified Starch Co., Ltd. (AMSCO), Kalasin province. AMSCO is a group of cassava processing facilities located in the same area consisting of a native starch plant, a citric acid plant and a modified starch plant, with overall capacity to process up to 700 tonnes of cassava root per day.  Approximately 5,110 m3 of wastewater is produced each day from AMSCO facilities and is directed into the existing open anaerobic lagoons which have an overall capacity of 788,700 m3.  The project activity comprises an Anaerobic Baffled Reactor (ABR) which is a high rate anaerobic wastewater treatment and a biogas recovery system.  Operated by Cassava Waste To Energy Co., Ltd. (CWTE)

name: 6 MW Wind Power Project in Maharashtra by PTC India
description: The project is located in Sinnar in district Nashik in Maharashtra state  and has a installed capacity of 6 MW of power generation which will be supplied to the regional NEWNE grid. The electricity will be purchased by MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited) and a Power Purchase Agreement has been signed between PTC and MSEDCL for evacuation of the power to the grid.

name: Hubei Jiugongshan Wind Farm CDM Project
description: Hubei Jiugongshan Wind Farm CDM Project, a grid-connected renewable energy project, is located in Tongshan County, Hubei Province, Centre China. The objective of the proposed project is to generate electric power from local wind resources, and supply to the Centre China Power Grid. The implementation of the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plants in the Centre China Grid. The proposed project installed 16 sets of 850 KW wind turbines in Jiugongshan Mountain, for a total installed capacity of 13.6 MW. It is estimated that the annual power supply to the grid of the proposed project will be 28.05GWh, with 2059 hours of installed capacity utilization. As a result, 31758 tonnes of CO2 emission reduction will be generated each year.

name: Gansu Datonghe Tiecheng Hydropower Station Project
developer: Gansu Mingzhu Hydropower Development Co., Ltd.
description: The Gansu Datonghe Tiecheng Hydropower Station Project involves the construction of a run-of-river hydropower station at the main stream of the Datong River in Yongdeng County of Lanzhou city in Gansu Province, China. The main objective of the project is to generate power from clean renewable hydro power in Gansu Province and contribute to the sustainability of power generation of the North West China Grid. The hydropower station will install 4 Francis turbines with a total installed capacity of 51.5 MW.

name: Ratchaburi Farms Biogas Project at Veerachai Farm
description: Veerachai Farm Ratchaburi Biogas Project  involves the capture of methane (CH4) rich biogas produced during the treatment of swine barn flushing wash-waters and its combustion for heat and power generation at Veerachai Farm in the Ratchaburi Province of Thailand. With the swine rearing capacity of 120,000 fattening swine, Veerachai Farm has recently invested in a high-rate continuous flow closed anaerobic treatment reactors to treat 100% of all barn flushing effluents produced from their swine rearing operations. Veerachai Farm has constructed these facilities to replace low-rate open anaerobic lagoon barn flushing effluent treatment systems.

name: Sinohydro Inner Mongolia Ximeng Honggeer Wind Power Project
description: The Sinohydro Inner Mongolia Ximeng Honggeer Wind Power Project (hereafter refers to as the “proposed project”) is to utilize wind resources for electricity generation through the construction of a wind farm with a total capacity of 49.5MW and a 220KV substation in the border area of southeast Abaga Qi and south XilinHot City, Xilinguole League, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, P. R. China. The proposed project is invested by Sinohydro Renewable Energy Co. Ltd. The electricity generated from the project will be sold to Inner Mongolia Power Grid, an integral part of the North China Power Grid. The estimated annual net electricity output and emission reductions of the proposed project are 131,970MWh and 141,932tCO2e, respectively. The proposed project is a grid-connected renewable energy project.

name: 6.0 MW Biomass based cogeneration power plant of Rama Paper Mills Limited, Kiratpur, Uttar Pradesh
description: Rama Paper Mills Limited (RPML) are into paper manufacturing and at present the company has three units involved in manufacturing of papers, like packaging, printing and writing grades and News print. The project proponent RPML has installed a 6 MW biomass based captive power plant. Since this project activity utilises a renewable energy source (biomass), it positively contributes towards the reduction in GHG emissions into the atmosphere. The project is a 6 MW cogeneration facility that meets the electrical and heat requirement of Rama Paper Mills Limited (having 3 sub units as per the paper grade). The project generates power at 11 kV which is recorded and stepped down to 440 V for the usage of the company

name: BHL Thanabhawan Project
description: The project activity is being undertaken by Bajaj Hindusthan Ltd at its 9,000 tonnes of cane per day (tcd) Thanabhawan sugar factory. The project activity involves installing of a new power plant next to an existing power plant, at the sugar factory in Uttar Pradesh, India. The power plant will use biomass, bagasse, a renewable biomass material that is produced from the milling of cane to generate electricity for supply to the grid.

name: McCommas Bluff Landfill Gas Processing Facility – Gas Production and Distribution Project
description: The project activity occurs in expansion cells at the McCommas Bluff landfill. Although the landfill is required under NSPS requirements to collect and destroy landfill gas, expansion cells are not required to install a gas collection system until five years from the date on which they initially accept waste. The project activity consists of the voluntary installation of a gas collection system prior to the effective date of NSPS requirements in expansion areas of the landfill. Gas collected is purified in Dallas Clean Energy’s processing plant at the landfill and injected into a pipeline distribution network or flared.

name: Chol Charoen Group Wastewater Treatment with Biogas System I (Kampangpet)
project_type: Energy industries (renewable/non-renewable sources); Waste handling and disposal
description: The project activity involves recovery of fugitive biogas from the wastewater released from tapioca starch processing plant. The recovered biogas is used in a boiler to generate heat for the starch drying process as well as used in gas engines to generate electricity. The produced electricity will be used to meet the power requirement of the starch processing plant and may later be supplied to national-owned grid in the future. After satisfying the above demands, surplus biogas, if any, is flared for safety purpose. The project has a total electrical generation capacity of less than 15 MWel and will generate emission reductions less than 60 ktCO2e per year.

name: Wastewater Treatment with Biogas Technology in a Tapioca Processing Plant at P.V.D. International Company Limited, Thailand
description: The proposed project activity involves the installation of an anaerobic wastewater treatment facility with methane capture, based on the Upflow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (UASB) technology. The prevailing wastewater treatment facility is an open lagoon-based ponding system without methane capture. The quality of the treated water, if discharged into an open water body, should be as per the effluent standards regulated by the Thai authority. Although the present facility is able to treat the wastewater to meet these effluent standards, the issue of releasing wastewater is irrelevant, as all the wastewater is either recycled in the plant itself and/or provided to the farmers as a valuable fertilizer in the agricultural field.

name: Garganta da Jararaca Small Hydroelectric Power Plant (SHP) - Atiaia Energia S.A. Project Activity
description: The project activity consists of the construction of a new small hydro power plant with 29.3 MW total installed capacity and a reservoir of 2.87 km². The plant is being installed in the Midwest region of Brazil, in Rio do Sangue (river). Small hydro in Brazil must have installed capacity between 1 MW and 30 MW and reservoir area less than 3 km², or, if the area is between 3 km² and 13 km², it should have a minimum environmental impact. Garganta da Jararaca plant complies with the Brazilian legal criteria that define small hydropower plants. The turbine system consists of two units of 15.10 MW each, and two generators of 14.65 MW.

name: The VCF Group Biogas Projects at Nipat and Songphol Farm
description: The project, using technology developed by the Energy Research and Development Institute (ERDI), Chiang Mai University, Thailand, involves the installation of High suspensions solid Up-flow Anaerobic Sludge Blanket (HUASB) reactors at 3 pig-farms under the VCF Group. The VCF group is a large pig farms company and the farms included under this project activity are named Nipat, Songphol 1 and Songphol 2. All farms are located in the Ratchaburi province in the southwest region of Thailand approximately 100 km west of Bangkok.

name: Gansu Huanghe Bingling Hydropower Station Project
developer: Gansu Diantou Bingling Hydropower Development Co.
description: The construction and operation of a new hydropower plant is the main objective of the proposed project activity at the main stream of the Yellow River at the border of Yongjing County and Jishishan County of Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture in Gansu Province, China. The project will involve the construction of a dam with a maximum height of 61 meter; the power-house is integrated in the dam with the turbines installed at the base of the dam. A total capacity of 240MW will be installed employing five bulb-type propeller turbines with an individual capacity of 48MW. The expected annual operating hours of 4,058 hours will result in an expected net annual power supply of 954.088 millions of kWh. The electricity generated by the proposed project will than dis-place part of the electricity generated by North West China Grid which is dominated by fossil fuel-fired power plants: an annual average emission reduction of 764,452 tCO2eq is therefore estimated to occur with the proposed project.

name: Xinjiang Dabancheng Sanchang Phase III Wind Power Project
developer: Xinjiang Tianfeng Wind Power Co., Ltd.
description: Xinjiang Dabancheng Sanchang Phase III Wind Power Project (hereafter referred as the proposed project) is located in Tuoli Village, Urumchi County, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, Northwest China. Totally 33 sets of 1500kW wind turbines (Goldwind 77/1500kW) will be installed, providing a total capacity of 49.5MW. With average annual electricity supplied of 136,610 MWh, the proposed project will achieve CO2 emission reduction by replacing electricity generated by fossil fuel fired power plant connected into Northwest China Power Grid. The proposed project is estimated to deliver 134,943 tonnes CO2 emission reduction annually.

name: Henan Nanyang Fangcheng Wind Farm Project
developer: Zhongdiantou Nanyang  Fangcheng Wind Power Co. Ltd
description: Henan Nanyang Fangcheng Wind Farm Project is located in Er’langMiao Town, Fangcheng County in the Southwest of Henan Province. The primary objective of the proposed project is to generate renewable electricity for the Central China Grid (CCG). Equivalent electricity service provided by the Central China Grid is chosen as the baseline scenario for the proposed project activity. The proposed project activity is a new wind power project, the scenario existing is the same with the baseline scenario.

name: Inner Mongolia Bayinhanggai 49.5MW Wind Farm Project
developer: Shanxi Zhangze Electric Power Co., Ltd
description: Inner Mongolia Bayinhanggai 49.5MW Wind Farm Project is located in Urad ZhongQi, Bayan Nur City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. The primary objective of the proposed project is to generate renewable electricity to meet the ever-increasing demand in the Inner Mongolia Grid and the North China Grid (NCG). According to the conditions of the local wind resource, the proposed project will have the total installed capacity of 49.5 MW. The proposed project is expected to delivery 107 GWh annually to the NCG through the Inner Mongolia Grid. The project operation life is 20 years. Electricity generated by the proposed project will displace part of the electricity generated by the NCG which is dominated by fuelfired power plants. Thus, the greenhouse gas (GHG) emission reductions could be achieved. Theestimated annual GHG emission reductions are 115,079 tCO2e during the first crediting period.

name: Heilongjiang Shaobaishan Wind Power Project
developer: Yichun Longyuan Hero Asia Wind Power Co., Ltd
description: renewable energy project developed by Yichun Longyuan Hero Asia Wind Power Co., Ltd. The proposed project is to be located in Jinshantun district Yichun City, Heilongjiang Province, China. The purpose of the proposed project is to generate electricity using wind power resources in the project region and to sell into Northeast Power Grid (NEPG). The proposed project involves the installation of 33 sets of 1,500kW wind turbines, for a total installed capacity of 49.5 MW. It is estimated that the annual generated output will be 112,600 MWh. The project is a new project, and the situation prior to the project is the same as the baseline scenario, which is that the NEPG would provide the same amount of electricity. The electricity generated from the project can displace part of the power from the grid, and the expected annual GHG emission reductions are 128,442 tCO2e.

name: 28MW Jinkouba Hydropower Project
developer: Jintai Hydropower Co. Ltd in Gansu Province
description: The 28MW Jinkouba Hydropower Project, a run-of-river hydropower project, is located on Baishuijiang River in Gansu Province, China. The project will have an installed capacity of 28MW, provided by two 14MW turbines, with an annual net output of 127,900MWh.Generated electricity will be exported to Northwest Region Power Grid (¡°NWPG¡±) through Gansu Grid.

name: Curva de Rodas and La Pradera landfill gas management project
description: Curva de Rodas and La Pradera landfill gas flaring is a large-scale CDM project with multiple sites. The project is located in Medellin, Colombia. The total estimated emission reductions from the project is 1,171,245 t CO2e over the seven years crediting period. The project started operating during the summer 2008 and received registration by the UNFCCC on 6 February 2009. Green Gas, besides owning and managing the carbon credits, provided the technical solutions and has full control over the operation and maintenance of the project.

name: 9 MW Wind Power Project in Tamil Nadu by ACC Limited
description: The project activity has been essentially conceived to produce GHG free electricity from the Wind Electric Generators (WEGs). The generated electricity from the implemented machines will be supplied to the southern regional grid of India through the nearest grid sub station. The project activity consists of 6 numbers of Suzlon 1.5 MW WEGs totaling to a capacity of 9 MW. The project harnesses renewable resources (wind) in the region, thereby displacing non-renewable fossil resources resulting to sustainable economic and environmental development. The project is owned by ACC Limited whereas the supply of plant and machinery as well as post implementation annual

name: 2.5 MW Bundled Wind Power Project in Maharashtra (India)
description: The Wind Power Project of 2.5 MW installed capacity enabling generation of electricity by stateof- art 1.25 MW Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) in the State of Maharashtra was installed by Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Pvt. Ltd. (Pune) and Raj Promoters & Civil Engineers. Pvt. Ltd, Pune. However, the bundled CDM project activity has been proposed by Raj Infrastructure Development (India) Pvt. Ltd.

name: Thermal energy from Biomass at Mohota Mills
developer: The Rai Saheb Rekhchand Mohota Spinning & Weaving
description: The purpose of the project activity is to displace these coal fired units with biomass (rice husk) fired boiler and thermic fluid heater to meet the thermal energy requirements. The coal fired units are stoker fired and having low efficiency thereby leading to high coal consumption. The project activity involves the installation of fluidised bed combustion (FBC) type boiler and thermic fluid heater which have higher efficiency as compared to the earlier units. Thus the project activity leads to greenhouse gas emission reduction due to the displaced fossil fuel and improved efficiency.

name: Enercon Wind Farms (Hindustan) Pvt Ltd in Rajasthan
description: The project is located at Kita and Bhu village in Jaisalmer District of Rajasthan state in India. It involves the installation of 75 turbines of Enercon make (E-48), each of which has a rated output of 800kW, providing a total capacity of 60 MW. The purpose of the project activity is to generate electricity using wind power resources in the region and provide reliable, renewable power to the Rajasthan state electricity grid, which is part of the Northern regional electricity grid. The project contributes to sustainability in the region by reducing pollution, creating employment opportunities, improving the livelihoods of the local people. At a larger scale, the project assists Rajasthan and ultimately India in stimulating and accelerating the commercialization of grid-connected renewable energy technologies and markets in India.

name: Bionersis landfill project in Pasto, Colombia
description: The small-scale project activity is to build, operate and maintain a landfill gas collection and flaring system on the Antanas landfill in Pasto, Colombia. It is an anaerobic managed landfill, owned by the municipality of Pasto and managed by Empresa Metropolitana de Aseo de Pasto (EMAS – Pasto S.A.E.S.P.). The landfill started operations in April 2001 and will close in 2034. Since its opening, the landfill has received approximately 600,000 tons of solid waste from the municipality of Pasto and neighbouring municipalities. It currently receives 220 tons of waste per day. The landfill is covered with clay and vegetal soil on areas which do not receive waste anymore. The location details of the landfill are provided in section A4. The equipment includes inter alia a gas collection network, a high temperature enclosed flare, monitoring and control systems and civil works.At a later stage, the landfill gas collected may be used as fuel for electricity generation.

name: 5 MW Brahm Ganga Hydro – Electric Project at Kullu district of Himachal Pradesh, India
description: The project activity involves implementation and operation of a 5 MW (2 × 2.5 MW) small scale, grid connected, run-of-the-river Hydroelectric project (HEP), located on the Brahm Ganga Nallah (Tributary of River Parbati) in Kullu District of Himachal Pradesh, India. The purpose of the project is to generate clean energy in a sustainable manner, utilizing hydrological resource of the Nallah. The project consists of two 2.5 MW Horizontal axis Francis turbines. The project activity supplies electricity to the respective State Grid of India, which is highly dominated by thermal based power generating units.

name: Positive Climate Care 8.70 MW bundled Wind Power Project Activity in the state of Maharashtra, India
description: The project activity involved development and operation of grid connected wind energy based electricity generation facilities. In this bundled project, the aggregate installed capacity of 8.70 MW is contributed by 8 Wind Electricity Generators (WEGs), including 7.5 MW (1250 kW X 6 machines) and 1.2 MW (600 kW X 2 machine). The WEGs are part of Suzlon wind farms in Sangli and Nandurbar districts of Maharashtra. The electricity generated is fed to the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) grid.  The project is promoted by M/s Savita oil Technologies Ltd., M/s Rajesh Construction Company Limited, M/s Winro Commercial (India) Ltd., M/s Indian Products Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd., M/s Quantum Equipment Co. Ltd. & M/s KN Resources Pvt. Ltd.  In the absence of the project activity, equivalent amount of electricity would have been produced by conventional fossil fuels dominated power plants, which would lead to emissions of GHGs into the atmosphere.

name: Utilization of agro-residue biomass in a co-generation system
developer: ITC Limited - Paperboards & Specialty Papers Divis
description: ITC (Paper and Speciality Paper Division) PSPD, Coimbatore Unit (herein refer to as ITC), a part of the ITC Limited group, have installed a co-generation plant and is utilizing agro residues (waste biomass) co-fired with fossil fuel for the generation of steam and electricity.
